<think>**Evaluating one-hot decoder layout**

**Designing masked decoder**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);

    wire [9:0] enable;

    assign enable[0] = ((~sel[3]) & (~sel[2]) & (~sel[1]) & (~sel[0]))
                     | (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign enable[1] = (sel == 4'd1);
    assign enable[2] = (sel == 4'd2);
    assign enable[3] = (sel == 4'd3);
    assign enable[4] = (sel == 4'd4);
    assign enable[5] = (sel == 4'd5);
    assign enable[6] = (sel == 4'd6);
    assign enable[7] = (sel == 4'd7);
    assign enable[8] = (sel == 4'd8);
    assign enable[9] = (sel == 4'd9);

    always @* begin
        block_out = ({8{enable[0]}} & block_a)
                  | ({8{enable[1]}} & block_b)
                  | ({8{enable[2]}} & block_c)
                  | ({8{enable[3]}} & block_d)
                  | ({8{enable[4]}} & block_e)
                  | ({8{enable[5]}} & block_f)
                  | ({8{enable[6]}} & block_g)
                  | ({8{enable[7]}} & block_h)
                  | ({8{enable[8]}} & block_i)
                  | ({8{enable[9]}} & block_j);
    end

endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline select-to-output paths include shared decode fanout, buffering, and multiple output-combination stages. The default-to-block_a behavior can introduce additional selection logic after the ordinary case decode.",
  "rewrite": "Use an explicit mutually exclusive masked-OR mux. Fold selection zero and all default selections directly into block_a's enable, allowing default data to participate in the same parallel reduction as every other input instead of requiring a separate default-selection stage.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce select-to-output logic depth associated with default handling and expose NAND/NOR mapping opportunities. A numerical improvement over the 1.04 ns baseline is not established without running the specified mapping and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses ten shared enables and ten masked data terms per output bit. Parallel decoding trades select-net fanout against selection depth. Mapped area, compliance with the 1006.089920 um^2 cap, and zero electrical violations require evaluation; no measured candidate results are available.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, absence of parameters, port directions, unsigned widths, and combinational output-reg interface. Selections 0 through 9 return block_a through block_j respectively; selections 10 through 15 return block_a. Exactly one enable is asserted for every two-state selector. No storage, latency, assumptions, external dependencies, or don't-care input combinations are introduced."
}
